blurb: `exports capability { Clock }` lets other contexts depend on `Clock` and have it built for them, so the exporting context must also say how: a `provides Clock = … { … }` declaration. Without one, a consumer would hold a capability that nothing in the project can instantiate. Add the provider. (A derived capability, `capability Name = Kind`, cannot be exported at all; that is `bynk.exports.derived_capability`.)
summary: An exported capability has no provider in its context.
